details:
I don’t know if you guys got this before but I need to make sure if I’m doing this correctly.
Normally with VR chat on my quest two it works quickly to login with no slow problems but now it loads incredibly slow that it feels like it’s not loading. When I enter VR chat I get the little loading icon with the title and after waiting a few seconds or longer it will show the loading screen to the account, normally this goes by quickly but now it’s going slowly and when it’s nearly close to finishing it stops for a few minutes and then finishes. After that happens I’m stuck at the endless void and if I wait too long the game crashes (The type of crash when you look behind you it’s the same image of looking forward but upside down)
Please tell me what I need to do to fix this mess, i’ve tried everything. Reinstalling the game, trying my quest account instead of my VRchat account, deleting saved images from the game, turning on and off the Wi-Fi. But nothing seems to fix it! what do I do??
title: VrChat Loading/Login Problem
